title: Helpful pages, honest SEO and measuring what works

say: Helpful pages, honest SEO, and measuring what works.
This is the video for module three of the SEO course.
Google says its systems aim to reward content made mainly to help people, not content made mainly to rank.
People-first pages come from real experience, answer the customer's real question, and show clear prices, photos and local details.
Search-first pages chase keywords, copy others and pad the word count.
Many small-business pages fail simply because they say almost nothing: a heading, a photo, and call us.
Google's rater guidelines talk about E-E-A-T: experience, expertise, authoritativeness and trust. Trust matters most.
For a small business, that means simple, real things. Show who runs the business and where it is.

panel.heading: Build trust on every page
items: Show who runs the business and where
Use real photos of your own work
Give contact details and honest prices
Show genuine customer reviews

say: Use real photos of your own work. A caterer who has cooked jollof for 300-guest weddings, with her own photos, shows experience a copied article cannot.

say: Give your contact details and honest prices, and show genuine reviews. If you use AI to help write, check every fact and add your own experience.

say: Google mainly looks at the mobile version of your page, and most visitors use phones on costly data.
For example, Ifeoma sells Ankara dresses. In PageSpeed Insights, her collection page takes 6.8 seconds to show its main content. That measure is called LCP.

panel.heading: Ifeoma makes her page load faster
items: PageSpeed Insights: LCP 6.8 seconds, Poor
Resize photos to 1200 pixels, save as WebP
Turn on lazy loading
Remove the background video and unused plugin
Retest: LCP 2.3 seconds, Good

say: Her 24 photos come straight from her phone, about 3 to 4 MB each. She resizes each to 1200 pixels wide and saves them as WebP, about 150 KB each.

panel.rule: Good LCP is 2.5 seconds or less. Oversized photos are the usual cause.

say: Some sellers promise fast results through tricks. Sites that break Google's spam policies may rank lower or disappear.
Link spam means buying links that pass ranking credit. For example, Grace was offered 500 backlinks for 40,000 naira. She said no.

cards.d: Buying or selling links that pass ranking credit, or automated link building.
Repeating words or lists of towns, like tailor Lagos tailor Ikeja tailor Lekki.
White text on white, or many near-identical pages for every town.

say: Keyword stuffing means repeating words or lists of towns unnaturally.

cards.d: Buying or selling links that pass ranking credit, or automated link building.
Repeating words or lists of towns, like tailor Lagos tailor Ikeja tailor Lekki.
White text on white, or many near-identical pages for every town.

say: Hidden text and doorway pages try to fool Google. Instead, Grace listed her firm on her professional body's directory and wrote a useful article. She earned two genuine links, with no risk.

say: The Performance report in Search Console shows clicks, impressions, average position and CTR. CTR means click-through rate: clicks divided by impressions.

panel.heading: Funke reads her Search Console report
items: CTR = clicks divided by impressions
Before: 48 clicks from 2,400 impressions, 2%
After: 204 clicks from 5,100 impressions, 4%
Quick win: many impressions, few clicks
Note the date, check again in 6 weeks

say: For example, Funke compares 3 months before and after fixing her birthday cake page. Before, 48 clicks from 2,400 impressions. That is 2 percent.

Change one thing at a time, and give Google time to recrawl before you judge.

panel.rule: Change one thing at a time, then wait 4 to 8 weeks.

say: Clicks are not sales, so link them to business results. Set up key events in Google Analytics 4, such as taps on your WhatsApp button, and ask new customers how they found you.
Keep the report to one page, with one plain line under each number.

panel.heading: A simple monthly report
items: Clicks, impressions, CTR, average position
Top 5 searches and top 5 pages
Business Profile calls and new reviews
WhatsApp taps and calls from GA4
What you changed, what comes next

say: To remember. Write for people first. Compress your photos for phones. Never buy links or stuff keywords. Work out CTR as clicks divided by impressions. And change one thing at a time, then compare.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Write for people first, from real experience
Compress photos; aim for LCP of 2.5 seconds
Never buy links or stuff keywords
CTR is clicks divided by impressions
Change one thing, wait, then compare
